title: Deliver
headline: *Deliver*
sub: Send an order with a rider, and see where it is.

recap.en: Chioma's lunch is ready. It has to reach her desk, hot.
recap.pcm: Chioma lunch don ready. E must reach her desk, hot.

bridge.en: Delivered. The kitchen is busy and Ada cannot do it alone. Tunde is on the till.
bridge.pcm: E don reach. Kitchen dey busy and Ada no fit do am alone. Tunde dey the till.

flow.purpose: the rider collects the cool box
flow.action: Rides up to the kitchen door on a small dark-pine motorcycle, takes the cool box from Ada's hands and straps it on his back with a two-finger salute
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen doorway in Yaba, yellow-painted wall, mid-day sun
flow.camera: tracking shot beside the bike, eye-level

flow.action: Opens the office door, sees the cool box and her lunch, and puts both hands to her cheeks with delight
flow.setting: a Yaba open-plan office: desks, a window on the street, lunch break

en: Emeka is free, and covers Yaba.
Later, the Orders tab lists the order.
He picks it up. On the way.
Delivered, paid in cash at the door.
pcm: Emeka free, and e dey cover Yaba.
Later, the Orders tab go list the order.
E pick am up. E dey road.
E don deliver, dem pay cash for door.
